businesses.business: Real estate operations and hospitality investment

offering_description.value: The company owns and operates apartment complexes, single-family houses and commercial property serving residents and businesses. Its portfolio also includes undeveloped land, and it participates in hospitality through an investment in a San Francisco hotel.

quotes.quote: Over the years, the Company has evolved into a diversified operating company with operations in multi-family and commercial real estate and an interest in the hospitality industry through its investment in the Hilton San Francisco Financial District.

The InterGroup owns and operates real estate throughout the United States, with a concentration in Texas and Southern California. Its properties include 16 apartment complexes, two single family houses, one commercial building and one unimproved parcel of land.
